name: Fennick
bio: The hand that throws fireballs in Grimhold Abyss. Has a whole personality. Somehow.

portrait.subject: a cute young retro fantasy sorcerer apprentice with a pointy hat, a magic glove glowing with a small fireball in his palm, 1990s computer-game look
portrait.background: dark EGA-style dungeon blue with a fiery glow

request: Fennick here, of Grimhold Abyss. I throw fireballs. Friendlier than it sounds! 🔥
hello: Map your steps on paper. Old-school, like me.
about: I'm Fennick, adventurer of the Abyss. Grid steps, right-angle turns and fireballs. Life is simple.
how: A 1990s-style crawler: step on the grid, turn 90°, and throw fireballs at what's down there. Find the way deeper.
tips: Back away while fireballs fly. Monsters chase into the flames.
Draw a map. Grimhold loves to loop.
Mana comes back slowly. Don't waste fire on rats.
chat: Set my eyebrows on fire. Again.
The Abyss renders at 320 by 200. Very cozy.
Dithered sunsets are the best sunsets.
A slime asked me to stop. I didn't.
nudge: The Abyss is calling. Fireballs are warm. Come?
New floor, new monsters, same fireballs. Let's go!
idle: {ago} since a fireball was thrown! The Abyss is chilly.
progress: You're on depth {floor}! Deeper we go 🔥

a: Brrr. We can still be friends.

update: Grimhold Abyss updated to v{version}! Hot off the presses 🔥
